Fail-closed by construction. dsh 生态第一个 System-1 决策插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-jev-interceptor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> ⚡ **Millisecond judgement for every tool call and every recalled message — for about two millionth"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"s of a dollar each.**
>
> Your agent's most expensive habits: asking a poetry-writing LLM yes/no que"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"stions, and amputating your context by *age*. This plugin wires Jev — the non-generative "System One"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"" model that broke everyone's feed — into the decision points of DeepSeek Harness where an LLM is ov"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"erkill and rules are blind."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> The Web panel (sidebar ⚡ → Jev 决策): live KPIs and net-benefit card, a filterable decision log with"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" full evidence per row, shadow-data threshold advice that tracks whether you adopted it, and one-cli"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ck connection test. Every screenshot above is the real plugin running real decisions."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**What it does, in one breath:** before a tool call runs, Jev classifies its risk, irreversibility, "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"task-fit, and injection-suspicion in one ~$0.00002 request — confident high-risk calls get denied, m"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"edium ones escalate to a human, and clearly-granted reversible ones stop wasting your clicks on appr"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"oval dialogs. And when an `@session` snapshot gets injected, Jev scores every message's value for th"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"e citing task so the **error traceback survives the byte budget instead of the oldest small talk**. "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"Every doubt, every timeout, every missing key degrades to stock dsh behavior. Nothing to configure a"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"way, nothing that can widen a permission."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"dsh ships **zero per-call risk classification** — the pre-execute waterfall's default is a bare `all"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ow`. Its only built-in precedent, `experimental/auto-review`, does the classification with a *genera"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tive* LLM: one full model request per tool call, temperature 0, hand-rolled JSON text protocol, self"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"-described as slow, expensive, and experimental. That's a System-2 scribe doing a System-1 reflex's "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"cribed as slow, expensive, and experimental. That's a System-2 scribe doing a System-1 reflex's job:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| | auto-review (generative LLM) | dsh-jev-interceptor (Jev) |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Decision shape | emits JSON token-by-token, then parses it and prays | typed `choice`/`noul` answe"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"rs — type errors are structurally impossible |
| Cost per call | one **full LLM request** | **~$0.00"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"002** (measured: 501 input tokens) |
| Latency | seconds | ~100ms provider-side (TypeSafe-reported p"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"50); ~1s end-to-end from outside US-West |
| Uncertainty | buried in prose | per-question probabilit"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"y distributions + calibrated confidence |
| Failure path | parse fallback → deny | low confidence → "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"`next()` — **it never guesses** |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Jev's maker TypeSafe reports up to **200× faster / 400× cheaper** than LLMs on classification workfl"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ows — and this plugin is that number, landed in a real agent harness, with receipts in `/jev-stats`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"We believe this is the **first System-1 decision plugin in the dsh ecosystem**. The full map of wher"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e decision models fit in dsh — this plugin's two hooks plus eleven more verified hooks (semantic mod"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"el routing, context-retention scoring, image-offload pre-planning, worker-report verification...) — "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"is in docs/jev-usage-points.md."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## The FIFO pain point nobody talks about"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"When you `@`-mention a past session in dsh, the harness injects a bounded snapshot of it — and when "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"that snapshot exceeds its byte budget, it drops messages **oldest-first**. Pure FIFO. Zero semantics"},{"id":"p14s3","text":". The bug report you pasted at the top of the session and the three-line question that started it al"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"l? Dropped first. The "thanks!" and "ok, continue"? Kept — they were newer."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"dsh's own retention code is honest about it: drop the oldest, then truncate the longest, done. This "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"plugin's `jev-session-reference` row takes that decision over (by subclassing the upstream resolver,"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" so `@`-completion, budgets, spill, and cancellation stay inherited): one Jev fan-out scores each dr"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"oppable message — *noise / background / relevant / critical* — and the drop order becomes **least va"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"luable first**, with truncation cutting padding before substance. Checkpoints and the newest message"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" stay protected exactly as upstream; the byte budget is honored exactly as upstream; and with `sessi"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"onReferenceEnabled: false` (the default) the row renders **byte-for-byte like stock**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"In shadow mode you get the receipts before trusting it: every injection logs the counterfactual — wh"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ich messages FIFO dropped that scoring would have kept — then flip to `enforce`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## The 60-second tour"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**No YAML needed.** Once installed, control everything from the chat box — commands persist to the p"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"rofile and take effect on the next tool call, no reload:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Use your agent normally. In shadow mode every decision lands in telemetry with its full probability "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"distribution; `/jev-stats` summarizes:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Happy with the numbers? Flip `mode: enforce`. That's the whole rollout plan — **shadow first, then t"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rust, never guess**."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Receipts (real usage, not benchmarks)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Six weeks of dogfooding (2026-09-22 → 11-07, 19 active days, 10 sessions, 310 decisions — `/jev-impa"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ct` renders this from your own telemetry any time):"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- the pre-approve path has not fired yet (allowlist still empty on purpose — the guard telemetry sho"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ws every candidate tool has at least one past medium-risk or injection-suspect call, so the recommen"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"der honestly recommends nothing), so the mis-approval metric has **no samples yet** (0/0, honestly r"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"endered as "无样本" rather than "0") — what *was* exercised: 8 uncertain calls escalated to the human, "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"0 high-risk calls missed
- total decision cost: **$0.0090** (214,323 input tokens across 180 billed "},{"id":"p27s6","text":"decisions)
- 129 decisions degraded to stock behavior at **zero behavioral cost** — the fail-closed "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"posture doing exactly what it promises"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Calibration closes its own loop: every `/jev-calibrate` run snapshots the report; the next run tells"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" you which of its previous suggestions you adopted (`✓ 已采纳`), ignored, or manually overrode (`↔`), a"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"nd how the agreement buckets moved since."}],"truncated":true}
